title: foss-mcp known-defects registry
description: The structural contract of config/known_defects/<family>__<platform>.yaml (KD1, REQ-G3-015, workstream J): a committed, per-pilot ledger of UPSTREAM library defects this project discloses rather than silently works around. An absent file is valid (no defects recorded yet). The runtime loader (src/foss_mcp/indexing/known_defects.py) enforces the same structural rules in plain Python - this schema file is not shipped in the ingestion image - and adds the rules a schema cannot express: cross-item id uniqueness, real calendar-date validity, and the status/evidence non-contradiction rule documented in the loader's own docstring. Each entry is version-scoped (evidence.verified_on): once the served package version moves past that version, a served disclosure must say so rather than silently going stale (DECISION_LOG.md 2026-10-30, decision C).

schema_version.description: The format version. Always the integer 1.

pilot.description: The pilot this ledger is for, as <family>_<platform> (for example imaging_net).

defects.description: Zero or more disclosed upstream defects. Empty is valid: most pilots have none recorded yet.

id.description: A stable ledger id, for example IMAGING-NET-004. Unique within this file (enforced by the loader).

kind.description: The kind of thing subject.ref names.

ref.description: The exact symbol FQN or commit sha the defect is about.

applies_to.description: The scope this defect applies to: at least one of indexed_commit or package_versions.

indexed_commit.description: A single indexed library commit (40 lowercase hex) this defect applies to.

package_versions.description: One or more published package versions this defect applies to.

summary.description: A factual description of the defect, at most 240 characters - no editorializing, no blame.

user_action.description: What the caller should do, for example 'avoid this method' or 'use a newer version'.

evidence.description: How this defect was confirmed, and against what.

repro.description: A short factual description of how this was confirmed - not instructions to re-exploit anything unsafe.

verified_on.description: The exact package, version and date this defect was last confirmed on.

package.description: The published package name the defect was verified against.

version.description: The published package version the defect was verified against (contains at least one digit).

date.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) this defect was last confirmed. A schema pattern alone cannot reject an out-of-range calendar date (for example 2026-13-40); the loader checks real calendar validity.

status.description: open: still present; fixed_upstream: resolved upstream since evidence.verified_on; disputed: the upstream maintainer disputes this is a defect.
